Auto Loans

Auto Loan at 1.89% p.a. only for UAE Nationals

Thinking of buying a car? We’ve got the perfect loan for you at a special pricing of just 1.89%* flat p.a.

Emirates NBD Auto Loans also have a range of other features and benefits including:

Contactless digital journey** & fast approvals

0% Installment payment plan on Emirates NBD Credit Card for automobile purchases

First payment deferment up to 120 days***


*Rate is applicable with Emirates NBD Credit Card only (New or existing).
Rate is equivalent to 3.55% p.a. reducing.
**Applicable for Emirates NBD Salary transfer customers.
***120 days for Emirates NBD banking customers.
